name: record_interpretation
arguments: {"test_id": "T1", "per_hypothesis": [{"id": "H1", "verdict": "weakened", "why": "T1 FoldX ddG for R226C is +0.51 kcal/mol on AF-P31785-F1 (residue pLDDT 96.69), below the 2.0 kcal/mol destabilising threshold. H1 predicted a destabilised strand. The refutation criterion needs both a near-zero or stabilising ddG and an MD null result. The ddG half is met, the MD half is not tested, so H1 is weakened, not refuted. Literature MD instability (E7) and pathogenicity predictors (E10, E14, E15) are unchanged, but they do not replace the missing stability signal."}, {"id": "H2", "verdict": "unchanged", "why": "T1 measures folding stability, not cytokine binding. It does not bear on whether R226 contacts IL-2, IL-21 or IL-4R, so the H2 evidence (E9, E11, E17, E18, E20) is unchanged. H2 remains untested on its own refutation criterion."}], "uncertainty": "FoldX on a single predicted model has errors near 1 kcal/mol, so +0.51 is not clean proof of no destabilisation. Controls: R226H +10.76 and R226L +0.59 show the predictor does separate substitutions at this site, but R226L is close to R226C, so the scale is coarse. Stability in a model does not show tolerance in vivo. The MD refutation arm for H1 and any interface test for H2 are still not done. The T1 result also does not carry the in-silico literature MD result (E7), which used a homology model, not the AlphaFold model. Validation still needed: a second stability predictor, the MD matched-replicate run, and contact measurements in the experimental cytokine complexes (9E2T, 5M5E)."}

name: record_decision
arguments: {"favoured_after": "H2", "why": "Previous favourite H1 (stability/folding) was weakened by T1: FoldX ddG +0.51 kcal/mol for R226C (below 2.0 threshold; pLDDT 96.69), per E4, E6, E10, E12, E14, E15. Its refutation criterion was only half met (no MD arm), so it is not refuted. Strongest rival H2 (interface) was not addressed by T1, so it gains nothing from it, but it no longer trails H1 on the direct stability premise. H2's direct support is E9 and E11 (IL-2/IL-21 binding weaker, MM/PBSA), E17/E18 (residue 226 observed in cytokine-bound structures), and E20 (IL4R interaction).
